rendered: The paper does not give a cost per kWh for the NFA cobalt-free cathode pouch cell. The only cost-per-kWh figure in the text is the Department of Energy cell cost target, a background goal rather than a cost for that cell: "cell cost target of $80/kWh[1]". The NFA cell is discussed for its full pouch cell performance, and Table 1[2] gives only an estimated energy density improvement for the co-free NFA section ("250–275[3]" Wh/kg), not a cost.
